Tree Reconstruction:** The tree models are placeholders only. Do not preserve, trace, or reconstruct the existing leaf geometry, leaf mesh, canopy mesh, polygon edges, billboard leaves, or simplified foliage from the SketchUp model.

Instead, use only the tree's planting location, trunk position, trunk diameter, approximate height, species type, and overall visual mass as references. Completely regenerate the crown using natural botanical growth with realistic branch hierarchy, thousands of individually shaped leaves, fine twigs, overlapping foliage layers, irregular crown density, organic canopy edges, and naturally varying leaf orientation.

The foliage should look exactly like a mature real tree photographed outdoors—not a reconstructed 3D model. The canopy must have natural randomness, visible gaps, depth, translucency, and realistic interaction with sunlight. There must be no polygonal outlines, repeated leaf clusters, faceted edges, triangular shapes, billboard artifacts, or any evidence of the original SketchUp foliage.Healthy Vegetation: Reconstruct all trees and plants as healthy, thriving, well-maintained vegetation with rich, vibrant natural green foliage. Use fresh spring-to-early-summer growth, lush leaf density, subtle variations of emerald, forest, olive, and lime green, while avoiding dull, gray, yellow, brown, or desaturated foliage unless naturally appropriate. Leaves should appear healthy, hydrated, sunlit, and full of life with realistic color variation and natural botanical richness.

Generate this SketchUp reference image into a realistic photograph, similar to a photo taken with a DSLR camera at ultra HD 4K resolution, without altering the layout, geometry, or material textures.Enhance the material textures for greater realism.

Use physically accurate materials, global illumination, realistic reflections, HDR, natural color science, and the image quality of a professional architectural photograph captured with a full-frame DSLR and a 24–35mm lens.
Do not redesign the landscape layout or move any planted tree. Only regenerate the biological structure of every tree into a completely natural, high-resolution botanical specimen.
